Reporter

President Donald Trump’s standing among voters has edged up after his party staged its first-ever midterm convention, though Republicans remain on shaky electoral ground only weeks out from this year’s elections. The Focaldata/Financial Times poll was conducted from Aug. 28 to Sept. 2 with 2,178 U.S. adults participating.
